cc:Work.dc:title: f02_layered
cc:Work.dc:description: Two shallow layer stacks compare a cut through every SIMPLE operator with a LOCAL cut confined to attention. A ledger contrasts the crossing and its successor: row one gives a correction pending at 255, the full extent vector changes, and row three then gives a bonus pending at 259.
